{{Quote|Listening to Tendau Bendon morosely drone on about the mourning fig trees of some forsaken world made me want to me to take someone's life (my own is far too fabulous to even ''contemplate'' taking!).|[[Dyslogia Twang]]|<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|53|life/13425_1.html|SPECIAL FEATURE: Sightings by Twang}}</ref>}}
'''Fig trees''' were [[Tree/Legends|trees]] that grew on a [[Unidentified forsaken planet (fig trees)|forgotten]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Their persistence was a subject of concern for [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tendau Bendon/Legends|Tendau Bendon]], an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] who represented the [[Ottega sector/Legends|Ottega sector]] in the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
